correctness.rationale: The new statement has explicit finite domain and ordinary geometric quotient. A complete canonical orbit-flag model and signed cellular boundary are reconstructed from scratch. Each of 300 pairings has a unique active three-dimensional coface with a unit incidence, hence induces an elementary collapse. Exact van Kampen generators and triangular relators admit 462 verified defining-generator Tietze eliminations; their disappearance proves trivial fundamental group without an unverifiable computational leap. The resulting two-dimensional CW complex has Euler characteristic seven; integral H2 is free of rank six, and Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead proves the claimed wedge equivalence. All relevant calculations were executed from the actual embedded code and certificate and yielded the stated marker.

value.rationale: The square four-by-four chessboard is the first balanced case in the classical simply connected range. Transposition is the canonical inversion of partial permutations/shore exchange, its fixed set is a noncontractible wedge of three circles, and its covering space has a different 15-dimensional second homology. Giving a full integral homotopy type of the ordinary orbit space, with six sphere generators and no torsion, answers a natural and nonroutine equivariant-topology question not settled by a Betti/Euler count.
